source_name: World Bank WITS (World Integrated Trade Solution), mirroring UN Comtrade — India exports of HS 230400 by partner country, calendar year 2023
notes: Replaces an earlier dataset (SOPA OMY2024-25 ranking via Outlook Business) that named Germany among India's top-5 soybean-meal destinations by volume but gave no per-country figures to verify. This WITS/UN Comtrade calendar-2023 pull is the primary-tier, numerically verifiable source used elsewhere on this site — and it tells a materially different story: Bangladesh, Vietnam, Nepal, Iran and UAE are India's largest soybean-meal markets by a wide margin, while Germany's calendar-2023 figure is negligible (well under 0.001% of India's total). This does not necessarily contradict the SOPA claim — SOPA's OMY2024-25 (Oct 2024-Sep 2025) marketing-year figure is a different period and may reflect a single large shipment year, and EU country-level trade data is also sometimes recorded against the port-of-entry country (e.g. Rotterdam/Hamburg as EU gateway) rather than final destination, which can understate a smaller buyer's WITS-recorded total. The blog post has been rewritten to state both figures honestly and explain the discrepancy rather than presenting Germany as a guaranteed top-5 volume market — non-GMO origin, not bulk volume ranking, is the real reason a German buyer would choose India regardless of the aggregate figures above.
